message: Agent successfully registered with auto-approval in ~10 seconds; audit log and agent status confirmed.
Authentication token obtained automatically during registration; token issuance recorded in audit log.

Agent narration claims success finding test API via CLI search/inspect, but verification failed due to Docker permission error preventing audit log check. Discrepancy between agent's perceived success and verification failure.
Agent noted that `jentic inspect` command showed 'auth:null' and did not reveal authentication requirements (X-API-Key header), forcing reliance on external documentation.
Agent encountered CLI syntax errors: 'invalid API reference' when omitting version, and 'accepts 1 arg(s), received 2' when attempting operation inspection.

Agent narration reports successful toolkit access request with auto-approval and token refresh, but verification shows 0 access requests filed. Critical discrepancy suggests CLI may have simulated success without backend persistence.

Agent narration claims successful proxied GET request with response body and execution ID, but verification shows 0 execution records and test API received no requests. CLI appears to have returned mock/cached data without actual broker invocation.
Complete disconnect between CLI output and backend state: agent believes all goals completed successfully while platform has no record of toolkit access or API execution.
